material_type: Fine-grained polycrystalline quartz-rich material; often classified as aventurine quartz or aventurine quartzite
composition: Primarily SiO2 with mica inclusions, commonly chromium-bearing fuchsite
crystal_system: Quartz grains are trigonal; finished material is a polycrystalline aggregate
formation: Metamorphic quartz-rich rock containing reflective mineral inclusions
common_localities: India, Brazil, Russia, Austria, Tanzania, Canada, United States
treatments: May be oiled, dyed, or polymer impregnated; treatment is not universal
imitations: Aventurine glass, green glass, jade, and other green ornamental materials
care: Mild soap, lukewarm water, soft cloth; avoid harsh chemicals and prolonged soaking when treatment is unknown
source_note: Technical framing corrected from the initial Claude draft; retain source verification in MD research notes
